# API surface

59 route files, 115 exported handlers (64 mutating). 68 run behind a role guard, 8 behind `demoLockCheck()`.

## Findings

### Mutating handlers with no guard, lock or rate limit

None.

### Public writes to tables holding personal data

Mutating handlers without `demoLockCheck()` that write a table carrying a person-identifying column. Being listed here is not automatically a bug — a Studio-guarded handler writing staff records belongs here — but every row should be a deliberate decision. See *Privacy & Personal Data* in AGENTS.md.

| Handler | Guard | Table | Triggering columns |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PATCH /api/applications/[id]` | requireStudioAccess | `CourseApplication` | `firstName`, `lastName`, `email`, `phone`, `address` |
| `POST /api/profiles` | requireStudioAccess | `Profile` | `phone`, `directPhone`, `email` |
| `PUT /api/profiles/[id]` | requireStudioAccess | `Profile` | `phone`, `directPhone`, `email` |
| `DELETE /api/profiles/[id]` | requireStudioAccess | `Profile` | `phone`, `directPhone`, `email` |
| `PUT /api/report-issue/[id]` | requireFacilitiesAccess | `ErrorReport` | `senderEmail`, `senderPhone` |
| `PATCH /api/venues/inquiries/[id]` | requireStudioAccess | `VenueInquiry` | `email`, `phone` |

### demo-lock.ts docstring drift

The caller list in [demo-lock.ts](../src/lib/auth/demo-lock.ts) matches the 6 routes that actually call it.

## Table access outside a handler

Module-level defaults and shared helpers in these route files touch tables outside any exported handler, so the matrix above does not attribute them to a method.

|---|---|---|
| `/api/profiles` | — | `Profile`, `ProfileDepartment`, `Department` |
| `/api/profiles/[id]` | — | `Profile`, `ProfileDepartment`, `Department` |
| `/api/restaurant/menus` | `DayMenu`, `DayMenuItem` | — |
| `/api/restaurant/menus/[id]` | `DayMenu`, `DayMenuItem` | — |
